card.text: Explore Bianca, an inner moon of Uranus, through its measured shape.

introduction.text: Bianca is a small inner moon of Uranus discovered by Voyager 2. Measurements constrain its elongated shape, but do not supply a detailed surface map.

model.title: Approximate shape model
model.summary: A 64 × 46 × 46 km shape estimate. Two axes are assumed equal; gray grid: no imagery, not observed terrain.
